description: Use this after create_airtime_order, or after an ambiguous create result, to fetch the authenticated account airtime order by request_id or orderno.

orderno.description: SIMcloud platform order number returned during processing.

request_id.description: SIMcloud request identifier returned when the order was queued.

name: get_airtime_order

ok.description: Whether the proxied SIMcloud API request returned a 2xx response.

status.description: HTTP status returned by the SIMcloud API, or 0 when no HTTP response was received.

title: Get airtime order
